references.text: Jesus meets unbelief in his hometown, which parallels Mark 6:6 where his amazement at the people's unbelief is mentioned.
Jesus refers to the prophets' experiences with unbelief among their own people, reflecting his own experience in Mark 6:6.
The prophet Isaiah encounters unbelief among the people, which is a parallel to Jesus' experience in Mark 6:6.
Jeremiah faces unbelief among his countrymen, similar to Jesus' experience in Mark 6:6.
